text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Continuing her successful momentum, <chrname> draws 
closer to running in the Twinkle Star 
Climax.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the attention led to fabricated 
articles circulating, causing confused 
reporters to storm Tracen Academy in a 
major uproar!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There was consideration of temporarily 
revoking Tracen Academy's press coverage 
permissions, but Reporter Otonashi 
prevented it through sheer passion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A new project to clear up public 
misunderstandings, 'Close-up Coverage on 
Trainer <username>', was set to begin...!
